independence: Authored acceptance only, did not implement scoped runtime or deploy it.
purpose: Avoid full workspace detail reads by fetching only selected candidate while preserving data/authorization/summary/full compatibility and avoiding stale/wrong-candidate display.
requirementsBasis: Existing workspace behavior plus explicit owner-approved scoped optimization; REP-050–052 presentation remains unchanged.
coverage: Typed JSON numeric/string ID incl special Unicode and 200-character bounds
Summary and unfiltered full backwards compatibility
Selected full candidate URL for detail and polls, never broad workspace request
Merge selected into existing list without dropping other candidates
Same-view numeric/string selection change aborts old request; late responses cannot replace current candidate
Empty/error/mismatched response shows no other candidate or fallback

review.route: Auth before decoded JSON ID validation; no-store preserved; same envelope; not-found maps to404.
review.repository: SQL scoped before projection in candidate/runtime/report summary/report full/recursive lineage/material queries. Scope casts use bigint to support all allowed positive safe-integer IDs. Vacancy envelope unchanged.
review.ui: Scoped fetch depends on selectedCandidate; inactive responses ignored. Merge preserves unrelated list records; loadedCandidateId gate prevents previous candidate fallback.
review.postgres: Independent own-PG baseline RED executed. Candidate-image GREEN pending parent native runner. Six subcases: typed identities, own materials, missing numeric/public IDs including MAX_SAFE, old full/summary compatibility, unrelated unusable valid-JSON null candidate and manifest exclusion.

limits: Local route/repository boundary uses explicit test doubles, UI uses existing component harness. No PostgreSQL or latency proof is claimed by these31 cases. Real PostgreSQL runner and production performance checks are separate.

postgresBaseline.classification: Five product subcase failures plus failed parent; legacy broad summary/full compatibility subcase passes. Real isolated PostgreSQL16 and final valid-JSON null sentinels; trigger errors absent.
postgresBaseline.method: Own PostgreSQL container network none, Node22 previous immutable image; test uploaded, no production mutations/providers.

finalReview.inMemory: dashboardSource applies strict typed candidate ID filter before cloning, retains the full vacancy envelope and unfiltered behavior. No mutation methods changed.
finalReview.uiHooks: New loadedCandidateId/workspaceError states appended after existing state hooks. Rendering requires exact loaded selection. Error reset occurs in openCandidate event and async success, not synchronously inside effect.
finalReview.sql: Only dashboardSource query scope changed; all six candidate-related WHERE/lineage paths use nullable bigint comparisons. Existing candidatePk/lifecycle/mutation methods unchanged.
finalReview.testEnvironment: WORKSPACE_SCOPE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is preferred, TEST_DATABASE_URL remains fallback; same own-database prefix, consent, empty DB guard and synthetic fixtures. Alias does not alter oracle.
finalReview.gate: Focused UI31 and fixture14 GREEN; independent realPG baseline RED confirmed, new immutable-image PG GREEN pending parent runner. Full production-like E2E remains BLOCKED.
